description: This file contains unit tests for the FocusMapping logic in an Android TV application, specifically testing the index mapping and clamping behavior for focus navigation.

classes.name: FocusMappingTest
classes.description: Unit test class validating the focus index mapping logic when navigating from the second row to the first row in a TV UI.

methods.name: computeTargetIndex
methods.description: Helper method that clamps a focus index to the bounds of the first row based on the number of children in the first row.
